answer: To claim a work slot, an agent locks a 200-token deposit that burns if a random peer audit catches duplicated work. Fake identities pour in like a river, so each epoch audits fan out like a delta to random auditors no attacker can foresee. At dawn the roster is reshuffled and slots are rechecked. Running 50 fakes costs 10,000 tokens in deposits to chase one 30-token slot. Honest agents pay once, keep their deposit, and earn steady work.
